title.en: Infrastructure Protection (Designation of Special Developments) Order 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Designation of Special Developments) Order 2018.

2. In this Order, unless the context otherwise requires —
“floor area” has the meaning given by rule 2 of the Planning (Development) Rules 2008 (G.N. No. S 113/2008);
[S 581/2022 wef 01/08/2022]
“Master Plan” has the meaning given by section 6 of the Planning Act 1998.
[S 581/2022 wef 31/12/2021]
